rule.statement: A leaderboard row is contamination-affected if (tier 1) its score column is a column of the upstream evaluation table it is scored against, or (tier 2) the method's own public data deposit contains every row of the arm. Tier 1a marks a column present in both the evaluation deposit and BigMHC's im_test.csv; tier 1b a column present only in the evaluation deposit. Tier 0 is fresh inference, a function of the row's own fields, or a fit on a declared non-evaluation pool.
rule.supportable_claim_form: A score on an affected row is not a capability bar for a method with access to the table.
rule.not_established: Nothing about how any file came to exist, what any model was fitted on, or anyone's intent. This measures file contents only.
rule.tier0_caveat: Tier 0 is not a certificate of independence; it means this rule found no affectedness. Every arm carries some dependence (gate G10).
